ne30:1.1: And what is the conveying of descriptions?
ne30:2.1: “Therefore, of the one whose mind is guarded, right thought is his range”. This is the verse.
ne30:2.2: “Therefore, of the one whose mind is guarded” is the definition of the wording as to being.
ne30:2.3: “Right thought is his range” is the definition as to development for tranquility.
ne30:2.4: “Right effort is devoted to right concentration, having understood rise and fall” is the definition as to expounding for the ground of seeing.
ne30:2.5: “A monk who has reached dullness and drowsiness” is the definition as to abandoning the origin without remainder; “may he leave behind every bad destiny” is the definition as to development for the path.
ne30:2.6: The conveying of descriptions has been applied.
